menus.name: Ciel Bleu Signature Experience
menus.note: The eight-course menu with an aperitif, wine pairing, water, coffee or tea and a gift

bookingOpens: Online through TableCheck, with the menu paid in advance, or by phone or email (restaurants@okura.nl).
cancellation: Free cancellation, with the prepayment refunded, until 3pm the day before. After that the deposit is not refunded, and cancelling or cutting the number of guests costs €100 a person. Groups of 9 or more must confirm their numbers by 3pm seven days before.
groups: The Chef's Table in the kitchen seats 4 to 9 guests (Ciel Bleu Menu, Caviar Experience or the Signature Experience; not the Prestige Menu). The Starlight private room on the 23rd floor takes 11 to 18 guests; contact the restaurant.
dressCode: Smart casual. No shorts, sportswear, flip-flops, ripped jeans, caps, hats or hoodies.
